chunks.title: Travel and Expense Policy
chunks.text: For domestic business travel, the meal allowance is $50 per day and the lodging limit is $180 per night. For international business travel, the meal allowance is $80 per day and the lodging limit is $280 per night.

chunks.title: Travel and Expense Policy
chunks.text: Employees must obtain manager approval before booking business travel. The approval must identify whether the trip is domestic or international.

chunks.title: Expense Claims Policy
chunks.text: Expense claims must be submitted within 30 calendar days of the purchase. A receipt is required when an individual expense is more than $25. Receipts provide proof of purchase for expenses such as taxi fares.

chunks.title: Expense Claims Policy
chunks.text: Approved expense claims are paid in the next monthly payroll cycle. Questions about claims may be sent to expenses@northstar.example.test.

chunks.title: Flexible Work Policy
chunks.text: Eligible employees may work remotely for up to two days per week with manager approval.

chunks.title: Flexible Work Policy
chunks.text: Employees are not eligible for remote work during their first 60 calendar days. Questions may be sent to people@northstar.example.test.

chunks.title: Annual Leave Policy
chunks.text: Employees receive 18 days of annual leave each year. Up to 5 unused annual-leave days may be carried into the next year.

chunks.title: Annual Leave Policy
chunks.text: Annual-leave absences longer than 3 consecutive working days require at least two weeks of advance notice.

chunks.title: Learning Support Policy
chunks.text: Each employee has an annual learning budget of $1,200. Course approval is required before registration.

chunks.title: Learning Support Policy
chunks.text: The learning budget covers approved certification examinations, but it does not cover examination retakes.

chunks.title: Account Security Policy
chunks.text: Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for company accounts. Passwords must contain at least 16 characters.

chunks.title: Account Security Policy
chunks.text: Suspected account or security incidents must be reported to security@northstar.example.test. Passwords and other credentials must never be sent through chat.

chunks.title: Data Handling Policy
chunks.text: Northstar Services uses three synthetic data classifications: Public, Internal, and Restricted.

chunks.title: Data Handling Policy
chunks.text: Restricted data is sensitive information and must not be copied, pasted, or entered into public AI chatbots. Restricted data is retained for 90 days unless a legal hold applies.

chunks.title: Purchasing Policy
chunks.text: Purchases below $500 may be made directly. Purchases from $500 through $5,000 require two supplier quotations.

chunks.title: Purchasing Policy
chunks.text: Purchases above $5,000 require review-panel approval. Splitting a purchase into smaller transactions to avoid an approval threshold is prohibited.

chunks.title: Sick Leave Policy
chunks.text: Employees who have completed 90 calendar days of service receive 14 working days of paid sick leave per calendar year. Employees in their first 90 calendar days may take unpaid sick leave.

chunks.title: Sick Leave Policy
chunks.text: An employee should notify their manager by 10:00 a.m. on the first day of an illness-related absence. A medical certificate is required when sick leave lasts more than 2 consecutive working days.

chunks.title: Sick Leave Policy
chunks.text: Unused sick leave is not carried forward and cannot be exchanged for cash. Time needed to care for an ill family member is covered by the Care and Compassionate Leave Policy rather than this policy.

chunks.title: Parental Leave Policy
chunks.text: Employees with at least 6 months of continuous service are eligible for Northstar parental leave. A primary caregiver receives 16 weeks of paid leave, while a supporting caregiver receives 4 weeks of paid leave.

chunks.title: Parental Leave Policy
chunks.text: Employees should submit a parental-leave plan at least 8 weeks before the expected start date. When 8 weeks of notice is not reasonably possible, the employee must notify the People team as soon as practicable.

chunks.title: Parental Leave Policy
chunks.text: Parental leave may be taken continuously or in no more than 2 blocks within 12 months of the child's arrival. Unused parental leave is not transferable to another employee and cannot be exchanged for cash.

chunks.title: Care and Compassionate Leave Policy
chunks.text: Employees receive 5 working days of paid family-care leave per calendar year to care for an ill immediate family member or accompany them to a medical appointment.

chunks.title: Care and Compassionate Leave Policy
chunks.text: Employees receive 3 working days of paid compassionate leave for each death of an immediate family member. Compassionate leave should be taken within 30 calendar days of the death unless the People team approves an exception.

chunks.title: Care and Compassionate Leave Policy
chunks.text: Employees should notify their manager as soon as practicable and may be asked for reasonable supporting evidence. Family-care and compassionate leave do not reduce sick-leave or annual-leave balances, and unused days are not carried forward.

chunks.title: Remote Work Equipment Policy
chunks.text: Employees approved for regular remote work may claim a one-time equipment allowance of up to $600 in each 3-year period. Flexible-work approval must be in place before an equipment purchase is made.

chunks.title: Remote Work Equipment Policy
chunks.text: The remote-work equipment allowance covers items such as an ergonomic chair, monitor, keyboard, or laptop stand. It does not cover home internet charges, mobile-phone plans, coworking memberships, or meals.

chunks.title: Remote Work Equipment Policy
chunks.text: Individual equipment items costing more than $250 require manager approval before purchase. Reimbursement claims must include a receipt and be submitted within 30 calendar days under the Expense Claims Policy.

chunks.title: Responsible Use of AI Tools Policy
chunks.text: Employees may use only company-approved AI tools for work. Public or Internal information may be entered only after personal identifiers, credentials, and confidential customer details have been removed. Restricted data must not be entered into an AI tool.

chunks.title: Responsible Use of AI Tools Policy
chunks.text: Employees must review AI-generated output for accuracy, unsupported claims, and inappropriate content before using it. AI output cannot be used as the sole basis for an employment decision or an external customer communication.

chunks.title: Responsible Use of AI Tools Policy
chunks.text: A suspected disclosure of sensitive information to an AI tool must be reported to security@northstar.example.test within 1 hour. Employees must preserve the relevant prompt and output for the incident review rather than deleting the evidence.

chunks.title: Working Hours and Overtime Policy
chunks.text: The standard full-time work schedule is 40 hours per week from Monday through Friday. Overtime must be approved by a manager before the additional work begins, except during an urgent service incident.

chunks.title: Working Hours and Overtime Policy
chunks.text: Eligible employees receive 1.5 hours of time off for each approved overtime hour. Compensatory time off must be used within 60 calendar days and cannot be exchanged for cash.

chunks.title: Working Hours and Overtime Policy
chunks.text: Being available on call does not by itself count as overtime. Time spent actively responding to an incident does count and must be recorded in the time system within 5 working days.

chunks.title: Employee Wellbeing Benefit Policy
chunks.text: Each employee has an annual wellbeing benefit of up to $400 for eligible expenses such as gym memberships, fitness classes, and counselling sessions.

chunks.title: Employee Wellbeing Benefit Policy
chunks.text: The wellbeing benefit does not cover electronic devices, travel, meals, professional certification courses, or equipment purchased for remote work.

chunks.title: Employee Wellbeing Benefit Policy
chunks.text: Wellbeing claims require a receipt and must be submitted within 60 calendar days of purchase. Unused wellbeing funds expire at the end of the calendar year and cannot be carried forward.

chunks.title: Supplier Due Diligence Policy
chunks.text: A supplier that will access Restricted data or company systems requires security and privacy review before a contract is signed, regardless of the purchase value.

chunks.title: Supplier Due Diligence Policy
chunks.text: Supplier due diligence does not replace the quotation and approval thresholds in the Purchasing Policy. Both the due-diligence requirements and the applicable purchasing threshold must be satisfied.

chunks.title: Supplier Due Diligence Policy
chunks.text: Employees must declare an actual or potential conflict of interest before participating in supplier selection. Cash gifts are prohibited, and non-cash supplier gifts worth more than $50 must be declined.
